report:
Reviewed the complete record_required claim, all three ordinary implementation files (review.rs, check.rs, main.rs) and all six ordinary associated tests. No TODO/N/A entries exist. Captured fixture helpers, the shared workspace validation test and the review checklist as dependencies.

Implementation: start removes an existing anchor validation directory before publishing new input or summary, then writes a summary with no recorded timestamp and no output. capture_read only appends source fragments; it never supplies completed output or updates completion time. record requires an active review, validates output, rebuilds current inventory and rejects input_errors before writing output and then completion metadata. load_saved only treats output as completed when the summary records completion; missing/invalid files remain issues or an unfinished record. review::validate iterates every current anchor independently and reports missing/unfinished outputs, invalid output, requested edits and stale inputs. acceptable likewise requires present valid output, empty requested_edits and current matching context. Thus starting, reading and drafting do not substitute for record, and a prior completed report is not reused after a successful restart.

The necessary-but-not-sufficient qualification is enforced: a report with concrete requested edits can be recorded but cannot pass validation; a later source/association/fragment change invalidates a previously completed report. Both main::check and the shared Cargo validation test call the library check/ensure_valid path, whose review stage is mandatory for overall success. The captured checklist assigns recording to the review subagent and prohibits a coordinator draft from substituting for that completed review. Process ownership and semantic report completeness are reviewer workflow obligations, not authentication or natural-language completeness guarantees implemented by the record file format.

start_invalidates_previous_success_and_record_is_required asserts an accepted fixture becomes invalid on restart, output disappears, saved output is None and completion timestamp is null. Capturing an additional file leaves it invalid; only record restores validity, preserving exact input bytes and setting completion time. It also rejects rerecording or adding context after completion. interrupted_start_publication_states_cannot_reuse_an_old_approval simulates interruption after old directory removal, after new directory creation and after input-only publication. Both library and CLI remain failing at each point; a successful restart also stays failing until record. These tests directly address interrupted/abandoned state without assuming the command always reaches its last write.

incomplete_output_publication_never_satisfies_the_gate checks that a drafted output without completion metadata, a missing output after completion and malformed output cannot pass. invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review rejects recording before start, invalid report fields and changed input, asserts failed recording leaves no output and preserves saved input, then records a report requesting concrete edits and verifies the gate still fails. diagnostics_identify_missing_unfinished_stale_and_requested_edit_reviews checks CLI failure and anchored guidance for all four states, including source changes after approval. restarting_one_anchor_leaves_other_anchor_record_unchanged uses two accepted anchors, restarts one and observes overall failure despite the other's success, then records the restarted anchor and verifies success plus byte-for-byte preservation of the other record. This establishes independent conditions per anchor rather than a global approval shortcut.

The fixture helpers create real isolated model/source/claim inventories and invoke production review/check paths. The captured workspace test calls sage_meta::check(root).ensure_valid(), confirming Cargo uses the same required review state as the CLI. All state transitions and relevant failure outcomes have concrete assertions in associated tests. No further edits or unresolved behavior concerns were found.

This pass executed review start/read/record and source inspection only. No behavioral suites were rerun, and central test execution is not claimed as this reviewer's work. No source modifications. Dependency capture is complete for this assessment. No requested edits.
